{{Quote|Minimal electrical activity in the SW, 22% chance of frogs.|HoloNet News Weather Report|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|weather.html|Weather Report}}</ref>}}
A '''frog rain''' was a meteorological phenomenon in which [[Frog/Legends|frogs]] would "rain" from the sky. Like any other type of weather, frog rains could be forecasted with a varying degree of certainty.<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
In real life, it may happen that strong winds are powerful enough to suck up a school of fish or frogs and [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raining_animals "rain" them elsewhere].<ref name="Journey">{{WebCite|url=https://www.loc.gov/everyday-mysteries/item/can-it-rain-frogs-fish-and-other-objects|text=Can it rain frogs, fish, and other objects?|work=Everyday Mysteries|archivedate=20200715220231}}</ref>
